about.title: What is Lotto 6/45?
about.subtitle: South Korea's official national lottery — one of the biggest lotteries in Asia, running every week since 2002.
about.what_desc: Lotto 6/45 is South Korea's most popular national lottery, officially operated by the Dong Haeng Lottery Commission under the Ministry of Economy and Finance. Launched in December 2002, it has become a weekly tradition for millions of Koreans. The lottery is fully regulated by the Korean government, ensuring complete transparency and fairness in every draw.
about.step1_desc: Choose 6 numbers from 1 to 45. Each number can only be selected once. You can pick your own numbers or use a quick pick (auto-generated random selection).
about.step2_desc: Every Saturday evening, 6 winning numbers plus 1 bonus number are drawn from a pool of 45 balls using a mechanical drawing machine. The draw is broadcast live on national television (MBC).
about.step3_desc: Match your numbers against the drawn numbers. The more numbers you match, the bigger your prize. Matching all 6 numbers wins the jackpot!
about.draw_desc: The Lotto 6/45 draw takes place every Saturday evening in Seoul. The drawing is conducted using a transparent mechanical ball machine and broadcast live on MBC television, ensuring full public transparency.
about.prizes_desc: Lotto 6/45 has 5 prize tiers. The jackpot (1st prize) is typically worth billions of Korean Won — often exceeding $20 million USD.
about.prize_1_desc: The jackpot. Split equally among all 1st prize winners.
about.prize_2_desc: Match 5 main numbers plus the bonus number.
about.lucky645_desc: Lucky645 was created to bring Korean Lotto 6/45 information to the world. All winning data, draw results, and number tools are available in English and Bahasa Indonesia — making it easy for international audiences to follow and participate.
about.lucky645_feature1: Complete winning history from Round 1 to latest
about.lucky645_feature3: Smart number recommendations based on historical data
